newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Just Jeans bids for NZ's Underground.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Just Jeans bids for NZ's Underground.

text.p: Jeans retailer Just Jeans Holdings Ltd said on Monday it would bid for New Zealand retail clothier, Underground Fashions Ltd.

Just Jeans said its New Zealand subsidiary, Kimbyr Investments Ltd, would stand in the New Zealand market from January 30 at NZ$0.335 per share for 28 percent of Underground Fashion's issued capital or about 7.4 million shares.

Underground's major shareholder, Rissetto family interests, has said it would transfer its 71.4 percent holding to to Kimbyr Investments after the three day pause period required under New Zealand listing rules.

Underground Fashions is a womenswear retail chain made up of 41 New Zealand outlets and three Australian outlets. For the year ended July 31, 1996, Underground had made a net loss of NZ$2.6 million on revenues of NZ$27.5 million.
